== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Tonnika Sisters]] and [[Tonnika Sisters (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0 / Supplement). Appendix A matches Supplement, so there is no PC Errata column. Do not add the Reflections foil printing as a column. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
